findings.title: Plants that share a name are merged into one row in the stats table, and the table disagrees with Best plants
findings.where: GET /api/stats/harvests (backend/routers/stats.py, GROUP BY p.name, month) and the /stats page
findings.steps: Have plant 'Tomato' (Sungold, id 1) with harvests. Create a second plant 'Tomato' variety 'Cherry RR' and log 2000 g on 2026-07-15. Open /stats or call GET /api/stats/harvests.
findings.expected: Two separate rows (Tomato · Sungold and Tomato · Cherry RR), each with its own weight, matching the Best plants list.
findings.actual: The query groups by plant name instead of plant id. Both tomatoes become one row labelled 'Tomato · Sungold' that links to plant 1 and shows 3050 g. Best plants (grouped by id) lists 'Tomato · Cherry RR 2000 g' as No. 1 and 'Tomato · Sungold 1050 g' as No. 3. Neither appears with those numbers in the table.
findings.evidence: plants: [(2,Courgette,1200),(3,Lettuce,350),(1,Tomato,Sungold,3050,[0,2450,600,0])]; top_plants: [{id 4, Tomato Cherry RR, 2000},{id 2, Courgette,1200},{id 1, Tomato Sungold,1050}]. The test plant and harvest were deleted afterwards.

findings.title: The stats error state has no retry button
findings.steps: Open /stats while the API fails, e.g. /stats?from=2026-12-01&to=2026-01-01, or with the API down or returning 5xx.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry action that fetches again once the server is back, without a reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage with the error text is shown. There is no retry button, so the only way to recover is to change a date or reload the page.
findings.evidence: The SSR HTML shows 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' with no button. stats.vue does not use refresh from useApiFetch.

findings.title: The stats request has no 10 s timeout
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never respond), then open /stats or change a date.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 seconds and shows an error with a retry.
findings.actual: Neither useApiFetch nor the page sets a timeout, so 'Loading stats…' can stay up indefinitely.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts and stats.vue pass no timeout option.

findings.title: Months with no harvests are left out of the month columns
findings.steps: Choose From 2000-01-01, To 2030-12-31 with sample data.
findings.expected: One column per month in the chosen range, or at least the months between the first and last harvest, so the 'per month' breakdown reads correctly.
findings.actual: Columns jump straight from Aug 2025 to Jun 2026. Empty months are left out, so readers cannot see the gap.

findings.title: An invalid date shows a raw validation message
findings.steps: Type a 5-digit year into the From date input (browsers allow this), e.g. 20261-01-01.
findings.expected: A clear message such as 'Enter a valid From date'.
findings.actual: The API returns 422 with loc ['query','from']. apiErrorMessage turns that into 'Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime, invalid date separator, expected `-`'.
findings.evidence: curl ?from=20261-01-01 returns detail[0].loc=['query','from'] and msg 'Input should be a valid date or datetime, invalid date separator...'
